title: Enforce Emoji Descriptions With Statutes Across Languages
description: Every entity must have a unique emoji among siblings. The emoji must be the first symbol of the description. For definitions in code, remove specs/requirements/id/uri from docstrings and only leave a regular docstring with the leading emoji. Introduce two more statutes against missing emojis and non-unique emojis. Adjust all implementation, tests, and for all definitions in the codebase remove the parts from the current docstrings such as id and uri, specs, etc. For all programming languages.
summary:
Enforced emoji descriptions with statutes across all 5 languages (JS/TS, Go, Python, Rust, C#/.NET).

## Implementations Added
- **JS/TS**: `extractFirstEmoji`, `composeDescriptionMissingEmojiConstraint`, `composeDescriptionEmojiUniqueConstraint` in compose/js/index.ts
- **Go**: `ExtractFirstEmoji`, `DescriptionMissingEmojiConstraint`, `DescriptionEmojiUniqueConstraint` in compose/go/main.go  
- **Python**: `extractFirstEmoji`, `validateDescriptionMissingEmoji`, `validateDescriptionEmojiUnique` in compose/py/main.py
- **Rust**: `extract_first_emoji`, `check_description_missing_emoji`, `check_description_emoji_unique` in compose/rs/lib.rs
- **C#/.NET**: `ExtractFirstEmoji`, `CheckDescriptionMissingEmoji`, `CheckDescriptionEmojiUnique` in compose/net/Compose/Compose.cs

## Statutes Added
- `compose/description/missing-emoji` (Medium priority) in repo/cli/main.go
- `compose/description/emoji-not-unique` (Medium priority) in repo/cli/main.go

## Test Data Updated
- Added unique emoji prefixes to all 176 descriptions in metabolism.kit.compose.json
- Regenerated metabolism.zip with updated kit data
- Updated metabolism.meta.kit.compose.json, metabolism.shallow.kit.compose.json, metabolism.kit.reference.compose.json
- Updated nakagin-capsule-tower.meta.design.compose.json, nakagin-capsule-tower.shallow.design.compose.json
- Updated tambour.meta.type.compose.json, tambour.shallow.type.compose.json
- Updated hash expectations across all languages (JS, Go, Python, Rust, C#)

## Docstring Cleanup
- Removed 971+ URI reference lines (`[🏘️compose📚️...](repo://...)`) across all 5 language files
- Removed 950+ MUST/SHOULD/SHALL spec lines from definition-level docstrings
- Removed 212 boilerplate "holds the data fields" lines from Go

## .NET Fix
- Removed File entity from emoji checks (File struct has no Description property in .NET, same as Rust)
- Fixed net48 compatibility (replaced KeyValuePair deconstruction with explicit .Key/.Value access)

## Test Results
- JS/TS: 150 passed, 1 failed (pre-existing Change/invertDiff)
- Go: all passed except pre-existing Change/Metabolism 
- Python: 65 passed, 1 failed (pre-existing Change/invertDiff)
- Rust: 58 passed, 0 failed
- C#/.NET: 65 passed, 1 failed (pre-existing Change/invertDiff)
